import { Field, FieldItem, FieldLabel } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/field";
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/radio-group";

const RadioGroupDemo = () => (
  <Field>
    <RadioGroup defaultValue="comfortable">
      <FieldItem orientation="horizontal">
        <RadioGroupItem value="default" />
        <FieldLabel>Default</FieldLabel>
      </FieldItem>
      <FieldItem orientation="horizontal">
        <RadioGroupItem value="comfortable" />
        <FieldLabel>Comfortable</FieldLabel>
      </FieldItem>
      <FieldItem orientation="horizontal">
        <RadioGroupItem value="compact" />
        <FieldLabel>Compact</FieldLabel>
      </FieldItem>
    </RadioGroup>
  </Field>
);

export default RadioGroupDemo;
